hypothesis: A firm's next-month return follows the past-month return of the firms it is linked to, because investors process linked-firm news slowly (Ali-Hirshleifer; Cohen-Frazzini; Menzly-Ozbas); the long-short book of the most extreme names adds alpha to the reference book at 2x cost. Evidence grade B+.
universe: US common stock, price at least $5, 60-day median dollar volume at least $10M, market cap at least $500M, at least one link from two different edge sources; the short side also needs market cap of at least $1B and passes the short crowding filter (risk.md)
signal: Link definition, point in time at each month-end, filings variant only: (a) customer and supplier disclosures in 10-K filings extracted by deterministic patterns (the regex extractor, no model), weighted by the disclosed revenue share where given else 1, aging out 18 months after the latest supporting filing; (b) the 10 nearest 10-K business-description text peers; and (d) 13F common ownership (funds holding both firms at the latest quarter available, scaled by the geometric mean of each firm's fund count, top 10). Weights are normalized per firm per source and the three sources combine with equal weights, then row-normalized; no weight is fitted. Signal: link_ret_i = sum_j W[i,j] * R_j, the edge-weighted mean of linked firms' past-month returns with W[i,i] = 0, neutralized each month by the cross-sectional regression link_ret_i = a + b*R_i + c*log(size_i) + d*R_ind(i) + u_i; the residual u_i is the signal. Universe floor: a cover public float of at least $500M so the ticker map resolves; a firm-month with no resolved ticker or no gap-free bars is excluded and counted, and more than 5% excluded voids the run (data.md). Tranches: signal from the month-end close, trades the next session, monthly tranches with a 3-month hold (one third of the book re-ranked each month). Sizing: the 20 most extreme names a side planned, at least 15 a side, 150% gross, whole shares, 10% annual volatility target, net-exposure band per risk.md; the full quintile spread is reported as the research measure. Exit: signal exit at the rebalance with a broker-native GTC catastrophe stop at 3 x the 20-day ATR. Costs: the costs model at 1x and 2x, with the borrow stress grid of 0.5%, 2% and 5% a year on short value; hard-to-borrow names are excluded. Evaluation window from 2007 where history exists (the free feed starts in 2016; earlier history is a paid-data trigger, data.md). Decade stability and the Fama-French five-factor plus momentum alpha are reported, not gating.

holdout.rule: untouched holdout, never used for any choice; the longer of the last 3 years and the last 25% of the sample; consistency check only, the backtest gate is computed on the whole evaluation window from 2007

open_questions: edge source (a): the customer and supplier extractor is not built yet (TODO.md, Link graph), so this registration names it as planned; the backtest cannot run until it exists.
variants: the roadmap budgets 3 Link Momentum trials across filings, news and intraday; only the filings variant is named here, and news and intraday get their own registrations.
universe: the plan gives the filter rules and no ticker list; the list is built point in time from EDGAR filers, so the entry is a rule, not symbols.

evaluation window: the plan says from 2007 where history exists and gives no start date; the free feed starts in 2016, so a 2007 start needs the paid-data trigger and the window is otherwise 2016 onward.
holdout.start: 25% of a sample from 2007 to 2026-10-04 is about 4.9 years; 2021-11-01 is that computed date, and it moves if the window starts in 2016.
holdout.end: the plan gives no date; the drafting date is used.
decision.min_net_sharpe: the plan requires the 95% bootstrap CI lower bound above 0 and states no numeric floor; 1e-06 stands for 'above 0'.
decision.min_days: the plan states no minimum evaluation length for the backtest gate; 1 is a placeholder (MinTRL is computed by the harness).
decision.max_drawdown_pct: 20 is the plan default of 2x the 10% volatility target; confirm no stricter limit.

split.label_horizon_days: 63 is the 3-month hold in sessions; the plan gives no number.
split.embargo_days: the plan gives no number; 0 is a placeholder. Labels overlap by up to the hold length.
